question.text: Phase 1 gate run (cc5) needs two things only you can give. (1) WHICH epic in the ticks repository to run through ticfac run-epic: the ticks tracker has no small ready epic today (3dd 'Remove tk board' is childless and large; djo is deferred) — either name an existing one or create/authorise a new 2-3 tick epic there (a roadmap change I may not make). (2) Authorisation to touch the live ticks repo and spend: the run pushes an epic/<id> integration branch, .ticfac/runs/<id>/ records and a ticfac/run-<id> tag to github.com/pengelbrecht/ticks, opens a PR there, claims/closes those ticks through tk, and dispatches a real claude (or codex) runner three times with kill+restart from fresh clones. Reply with: epic id (or 'create: <title> — <2-3 tick scope>'), runner (claude|codex), and 'go'. Everything else in the epic is done: waves 1-4 merged on epic/qeu, gate and CI green (PR #1 draft).
